description: This file defines the BillableHoursService class, which contains business logic related to managing and logging billable hours, including methods for logging hours and retrieving recent entries.

classes.name: BillableHoursService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic for billable hours operations, such as logging hours and fetching recent hours.

methods.name: logHours
methods.description: Logs billable hours after verifying the existence of customer, user, and billing category IDs. Throws NotFoundException if any are missing.

methods.name: recentHours
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent logged billable hours, limited by the specified number.
